items.text: Round-2 d1 (option B — identifier + summary payload schema) is now baked into Contract Decisions as a concrete TypeScript SessionEventPayload type (sessionId, status, createdAt, backend, resolution, error?), with explicit exclusions for live metrics and internal URLs. The schema is the verbatim source for docs/embed-protocol.md.

Round-2 d2 (option B — vi.mock of @/lib/api/sessions per-test) is now the settled mocking strategy in Contract Decisions, the Testing Plan table (each row names its mocking approach), and Non-goals (a 'do not add MSW' prohibition). The decision forces a dedicated lib/api/http.test.ts that exercises the real network seam — added to Testing Plan, gates, and Definition of Done.

Round-2 d3 (option B — plain SessionDetailPage, no drawer) cascades through the plan: LiveDesktopDrawer.tsx and components/ui/drawer.tsx are removed from the migration table; a new 'New files (no source counterpart)' table lists SessionListPage/SessionDetailPage/http.ts/bridge.ts; Phase 2 step 5 explicitly excludes drawer.tsx; Phase 3 step 9 excludes a SessionViewer wrapper; Target End State, Rollout/Validation Checklist (added a 'rg components/ui/drawer ... — zero matches' invariant), Risks, Non-goals, and Definition of Done all reflect the drawer-free design.

sessionStore now drops the isOpen/open()/close() drawer slice (router navigation replaces it). This is captured in Coupling Points, Phase 3 step 10, the sessionStore.test.ts grep-backed assertion, and the Target End State invariant.

Phase 6 'Cleanup & Scenario Health' now defers the scenario restart to the user — the executing agent surfaces the restart command and waits, per the project preference that agents do not run vrooli scenario restart on the user's behalf. The Rollout/Validation Checklist and Definition of Done both reflect that the user-run restart is a checklist item and a DoD condition.

Readiness is now 3 across all five dimensions. Problem clarity and scope were already 3. Approach moved from 2 → 3: every previously-pending contract gap (event payload, mocking, layout) is settled and reflected in Implementation Strategy phases. Testable moved from 2 → 3: the Testing Plan now has a complete file-by-file table including the network-seam http test that the vi.mock decision necessitated. Risk awareness stays at 3 with two new mitigations added (payload-doc drift, vi.mock stub drift).

No remaining gaps that warrant another workshop round. The plan is execution-ready: every section has actionable content, every decision is settled with the chosen option cited inline, and every checklist invariant is grep- or test-verifiable.

plan_updates: Synthesized round-2 answers (d1=B, d2=B, d3=B) into plan.md. Major edits: (1) removed LiveDesktopDrawer.tsx and components/ui/drawer.tsx from the migration table and added a new 'New files (no source counterpart)' table for the four greenfield files; (2) added a settled 'Layout for /sessions/:id' Contract Decision pinning the plain-page design; (3) replaced the pending iframe-bridge payload note with a concrete SessionEventPayload TypeScript schema in Contract Decisions, with exclusions for live metrics and internal URLs; (4) added a settled 'API mocking approach in tests' Contract Decision specifying vi.mock + dedicated lib/api/http.test.ts; (5) expanded the Testing Plan table to name each test file's mocking approach and added lib/api/http.test.ts as a required gate; (6) added Rollout/Validation Checklist invariants for the drawer-free surface and the user-run scenario restart; (7) added Risks rows for payload-doc drift and vi.mock stub drift; (8) tightened Non-goals with explicit prohibitions on drawer migration, SessionViewer wrapper, MSW, payload-field bloat, and agent-run scenario restart; (9) reflected the user preference that agents do not restart scenarios — Phase 6 step 19 surfaces the command and waits. Removed the 'Open Questions (round 2)' section since no questions remain. Readiness raised: approach_solid 2→3, testable 2→3.
